referenceReason: The boundary convention changes from a strict threshold to an inclusive one.

issues.originalQuote: Equality is therefore not an exceedance.
issues.problem: Reverses the threshold rule: readings equal to 900 microsiemens per centimetre become exceedances, contradicting both the original and S1, which explicitly excludes equality.

audit.reason: The candidate otherwise preserves all substantive claims, methods, evaluation measures, limitations, attribution, uncertainty and planned-work status. Wording is otherwise identical, but the changed equality rule creates an internal contradiction with the definition of exceedance as a reading above the threshold.
